messages.title: Set the day down for a while
messages.body: Twenty minutes of quiet, and nothing else asked of you.

messages.title: Nothing here is in a hurry
messages.body: The beads move at whatever pace you set.

messages.title: A pause in the noise
messages.body: Ten Hail Marys are enough to change the air of a day.

messages.title: Come and rest
messages.body: Sit with a mystery and let the day wait.

messages.title: Somewhere quiet to go
messages.body: The mysteries are open whenever the day gets loud.

messages.title: One bead at a time
messages.body: The app keeps count, so you can just pray.

messages.title: Peace, at your own pace
messages.body: Ten Hail Marys or the whole Rosary; there is no wrong length.

messages.title: Today's Rosary
messages.body: The same quiet hour, kept once more.

messages.title: Your rhythm, right on time
messages.body: A few minutes now, and the day has its anchor.

messages.title: The hour you set aside
messages.body: Whatever kind of day it has been, the beads are the same.

messages.title: A small, steady thing
messages.body: The whole Rosary, or ten Hail Marys — the habit is in the returning.

messages.title: Prayer keeps the day's shape
messages.body: Begin whenever it suits; the beads keep no clock.

messages.title: Same time, same grace
messages.body: The Rosary asks little and gives much.

messages.title: A day with a Rosary in it
messages.body: That is all today needs to be.

messages.title: Mary is waiting
messages.body: She has all the time in the world for you.

messages.title: A word with your Mother
messages.body: The Rosary is simply time spent with her.

messages.title: She holds out her hand
messages.body: Take up the beads and walk the mysteries with her.

messages.title: All yours, Mary
messages.body: Give her these few minutes and she will give them to her Son.

messages.title: Through her, to him
messages.body: Every Hail Mary you pray she carries straight to Jesus.

messages.title: The Mother of God knows your name
messages.body: Come and tell her what the day has held.

messages.title: Hail Mary
messages.body: Fifty of them, and she is nearer than when you began.

messages.title: Today's mystery is ready
messages.body: The scene, the scripture, and the prayers, all in one place.

messages.title: There is always more in it
messages.body: Eight centuries of saints have not exhausted the mysteries.

messages.title: A quiet moment awaits
messages.body: The Rosary is here whenever you are ready.

messages.title: Today's mysteries are ready
messages.body: A few minutes of stillness amid the day.

messages.title: The Rosary is close by
messages.body: Peace begins with a single Hail Mary.

messages.title: The beads are where you left them
messages.body: Pick them up whenever the day allows.

messages.title: Mary keeps a place for you
messages.body: Come sit with the mysteries a while.

messages.title: An invitation to stillness
messages.body: Sit with one mystery and see where it goes.

messages.title: Grace in the ordinary
messages.body: Ten Hail Marys can change the whole day.

intentions.name: Praying Every Day
intentions.detail: To make the Rosary part of each day

intentions.name: Learning the Rosary
intentions.detail: New to it, or coming back after a while
